posts.headline: Seven straight editions and Put it in Ra is still 0-2 — One Nut Barner's 20-8, 1.5-average-finish pedigree isn't cracked anymore, it's a full excavation site.
posts.detail: 238.06 points for on the season proves the roster isn't the problem, which makes the 0-2 record even more damning for a franchise that finished top-2 in both its seasons.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers are 2-0 with a league-high 344.18 points and this column is officially tired of being the only one who cares.
posts.detail: triciagloston's 6-7-1 career mark says middling, but the actual 2026 numbers say best team in the league — someone besides me needs to start sweating this.

posts.headline: Thicks is 2-0, sure, but a reigning champ sitting at 263.62 points through two weeks is still just squeaking by, not steamrolling anybody.
posts.detail: 14-14 career record and a title mean the bar is higher than 'undefeated on fumes' — this league expects a coronation, not a survival story.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy way or the Hard Way is 0-2 with a league-worst 165.84 points, and Auntie Thomas has officially out-bottom-fed his own 10-average-finish résumé.
posts.detail: A 6-8 career record already screamed bottom-feeder, but posting the fewest points in the entire league is a new personal low even for this franchise.

posts.headline: Sasinci climbed to 1-1 but Big Head's title banner is still buried under a 13-15 career record with nothing to show for it this week.
posts.detail: 245.38 points for isn't embarrassing, but a defending-pedigree contender treading water at .500 with Milk Magnus energy isn't scaring anybody in this league.
